cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: The Handoff Already Happened
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility by returning to earlier offers until the task seems to have been assigned all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said you'd take it from here. Start with these wedding guest emails; I taught you to answer arrival questions before people set off.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant I'd answer the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've remembered to welcome them. These people are asking when that door opens. Reply to the first one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read your offer back: 'I'll handle arrivals.' You used to need me to break a job into steps. This is the step before the doorbell; tell them two o'clock.
